title: AS2 compiler: IIFE and computed-call expressions silently return undefined
description: In compiler.ts around line 1544, call expressions whose callee is not an Identifier or MemberExpr (e.g. IIFEs like (function(){})(), computed calls like arr[i]()) fall into a 'not supported in MVP; push undefined' branch and are never invoked. Fix: implement proper callee compilation for these forms — push the function object, push args, call.
